text:
Title is in the **friend, in fee simple absolute**. The gift over to the sister's children is a shifting executory interest that is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, because a child born shortly before the sister's death could reach 25 more than 21 years after her death. Since the grantor kept no reversion, the sons, the daughter, and the shopkeeper hold nothing.

CONFIDENCE: 70
